## How do I enter and pay a vendor bill?

<a id="paying-bills"></a>

Two ways, depending on when you pay. Pay later: enter the bill now and pay it from Pay Bills. Pay now: write a check.

**Where:** **Purchases › Enter Bills** (`/bills`)

1. Pay later: open Enter Bills, click "New Bill", pick the vendor, the amount and what it was for. → **Purchases › Enter Bills** (`/bills`)
2. When you pay: open Pay Bills, tick the bills, choose the bank account and payment date, then pay. → **Purchases › Pay Bills** (`/pay-bills`)
3. Pay now (check, debit card or cash): use Write Checks instead. → **Purchases › Write Checks** (`/expenses?new=1`)

> Good to know: A bill entered in Enter Bills must be paid in Pay Bills, not with Write Checks, or the vendor still shows as owed.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I enter and pay a vendor bill?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I record something I paid for right away?

<a id="write-check"></a>

Write Checks records money you paid right away by check, debit card or cash, and what it was for.

**Where:** **Purchases › Write Checks** (`/expenses?new=1`)

1. Open Write Checks (Ctrl+W). → **Purchases › Write Checks** (`/expenses?new=1`)
2. Pick the bank account, the payee and the expense account, and enter the amount. The payee can be a vendor or someone on the Other Names list.
3. Save. To print it later, mark it "to be printed" and use Print Checks. → **Purchases › Print Checks** (`/print-checks`)

> Good to know: Many at once? Type them into the account’s register, or paste them into Enter many transactions.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I record something I paid for right away?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I record credit card charges?

<a id="credit-card-charges"></a>

Enter each charge on Enter Credit Card Charges, type them into the card’s register, or import the card statement and review the lines like a bank account.

**Where:** **Enter Credit Card Charges** (`/expenses?new=1&type=cc_charge`)

1. One charge: open Enter Credit Card Charges (menu: Banking > Enter Credit Card Charges). Pick the card, the payee, the expense account and the amount. → **Enter Credit Card Charges** (`/expenses?new=1&type=cc_charge`)
2. Several: open Registers and pick the credit card account. Type a row and press Enter: it saves as a card charge. → **Banking › Registers** (`/registers`)
3. A whole statement: import the card statement file and review the lines. → **Banking › Bank Feeds** (`/bank-feeds`)
4. Reconcile the card against its statement. At the end you can write a check for the balance. → **Banking › Reconcile** (`/reconcile`)

> Good to know: A credit card must be set up as a Credit Card account, not a bank account, or its amounts show the wrong way round.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I record credit card charges?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I print checks?

<a id="print-checks"></a>

Print Checks prints the checks you marked "to be printed" on your check stock: voucher, 3 per sheet or wallet.

**Where:** **Purchases › Print Checks** (`/print-checks`)

1. Open Print Checks. → **Purchases › Print Checks** (`/print-checks`)
2. First time: open Printer Setup and choose the check paper and check style, and where the check sits on the page.
3. Pick the Bank Account and the Next Check Number, tick the checks and print.
4. Answer "Did checks print OK?" so the check numbers are recorded.

> Good to know: Paychecks and customer refund checks can be added to the same queue from this screen.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I print checks?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I record a credit or refund from a vendor?

<a id="vendor-credit"></a>

A vendor credit lowers what you owe a vendor, for a return or an overcharge. You use it when you pay their bills.

**Where:** **Purchases › Vendor Credits** (`/vendor-credits`)

1. Open Vendor Credits and click "New Vendor Credit". Pick the vendor, the date and the account or item, and the amount. → **Purchases › Vendor Credits** (`/vendor-credits`)
2. On the credit, click "Apply Credit" and pick the bill it reduces. The vendor sent the money back instead? Click "Record Refund" and choose the bank account it went into.
3. Pay what is left of the bill in Pay Bills. → **Purchases › Pay Bills** (`/pay-bills`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I record a credit or refund from a vendor?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I order from a vendor and receive the items?

<a id="purchase-orders"></a>

A purchase order is an order you send a vendor. It does not change your books until the items arrive or the bill comes.

**Where:** **Purchases › Purchase Orders** (`/purchase-orders`)

1. Open Purchase Orders and click "New Purchase Order". Pick the vendor and the items you are ordering. → **Purchases › Purchase Orders** (`/purchase-orders`)
2. Items arrived before the bill: open Receive Items, pick the vendor and the purchase order, and enter what arrived. → **Purchases › Receive Items** (`/item-receipts`)
3. When the bill comes: open Bill for received items, pick the vendor and the item receipt, check the amounts and save. → **Purchases › Bill for received items** (`/receive-bill`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I order from a vendor and receive the items?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I turn a receipt photo into an expense?

<a id="capture-receipts"></a>

Drop a receipt photo or PDF anywhere in the app. Ironbooks reads it on this computer and fills in a new expense or bill for you to check.

**Where:** **Purchases › Receipts** (`/receipts`)

1. Drag a receipt anywhere in the app, or open Receipts and click "Add receipts". → **Purchases › Receipts** (`/receipts`)
2. From your phone: click "Send from your phone", make a phone link and scan the code with your phone’s camera. Take a photo of each receipt and tap Send. → **Send receipts from your phone** (`/receipts/phone`)
3. Open each receipt in the list, check what was read and save it as an expense or a bill.

> Good to know: Reading uses built-in text recognition. A local AI model can read photos too: see "How receipts are read" on the Receipts screen.
>
> Good to know: The phone must be able to reach this computer (the same network or your tailnet).

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I turn a receipt photo into an expense?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I add a vendor?

<a id="add-vendor"></a>

Vendors lists everyone you buy from, with their details, the balance you owe and history.

**Where:** **Purchases › Vendors** (`/vendors`)

1. Open Vendors and click "Add Vendor". Fill in the name and details and save. → **Purchases › Vendors** (`/vendors`)
2. Paying a contractor you will send a 1099? Enter their tax ID on the vendor.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I add a vendor?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I prepare 1099s for contractors?

<a id="form-1099"></a>

The 1099 Worksheets total what you paid each vendor for the year, by box, from the expense accounts you map.

**Where:** **1099 Worksheets** (`/reports/1099`)

1. Open the 1099 Worksheets and choose the Calendar Year. → **1099 Worksheets** (`/reports/1099`)
2. Under "Account-to-Box Mapping", choose which expense accounts count toward each box, then "Save Mapping".
3. Check the list. "Not on file" under Tax ID means the vendor still needs one. "Download CSV" exports the figures.
4. 1099 E-File prepares the file for filing. → **Admin › 1099 E-File** (`/reports/1099-efile`)

> Good to know: Check the figures against current IRS rules before filing.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I prepare 1099s for contractors?", or ask Ask AI.*
